title: Band-9 Samples: What kind of information about yourself have you put on social media? [Why/why not?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 14 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 2 question: “What kind of information about yourself have you put on social media? [Why/why not?]” Sample 1 Female Male I utilize social media as a platform to create a digital repository of my life experiences, particularly focusing on my family and myself. By uploading images that encapsulate our most treasured events and accomplishments, I’m able to establish a visual narrative that we can all reflect upon and appreciate. This practice enables me to reinforce familial bonds and maintain a valuable record of our collective journey. Sample 2 Female Male Personally, I use social media to showcase my culinary adventures and travel escapades. I find that doing so allows me to create an online repository of sorts, which I can later revisit to reminisce about enjoyable moments. This approach helps me keep track of memorable experiences while sharing them with friends and family. Sample 3 Female Male My social media presence primarily revolves around my hobbies and passions, as I believe it’s a fantastic platform to connect with like-minded individuals. I’ve shared information about my interests in photography, travel, and literature, as well as some of my creative works, such as photographs and travelogues. By doing so, I hope to foster connections with others who share similar interests and engage in meaningful conversations, while maintaining a degree of personal privacy. Sample 4 Female Male I’ve carefully curated the information I share on social media to reflect my professional persona. As a marketing specialist, I believe it’s essential to establish a credible online presence that highlights my skills and expertise. Therefore, I’ve shared details about my educational background, work experience, and accomplishments in the field, along with relevant articles and thought-provoking content that showcases my industry knowledge. Sample 5 Female Male I’ve opted to share a combination of personal interests and achievements on my social media profiles. This includes hobbies, travel experiences, and notable accomplishments. My intention is to create a holistic representation of my personality, which allows me to form genuine connections with others who share similar passions. In essence, it serves as a platform for fostering meaningful relationships and exchanging diverse perspectives. Sample 6 Female Male On social media, I’ve opted to share only minimal personal information about myself. The primary reason being privacy concerns, as I believe it’s crucial to safeguard one’s personal data from potential misuse. I primarily use social media to stay informed about current events and engage in discussions on topics that interest me, such as technology and environmental issues. Consequently, my profile focuses on these areas, rather than divulging personal details. Sample 7 Female Male I must say, I am quite circumspect when it comes to revealing information about myself on social media. My rationale behind this choice lies in my concern for the negative implications of oversharing, such as identity theft and targeted advertising. As a result, I only provide basic information, such as my name and location, which enables me to stay connected with acquaintances and colleagues while safeguarding my personal data. Sample 8 Female Male When it comes to social media, I adopt a rather conservative approach in terms of revealing personal details. My primary objective is to curate a professional online presence, emphasizing my skills and accomplishments rather than delving into my private life. This strategy has proven to be quite beneficial in augmenting my career prospects. Sample 9 Female Male I have taken a rather unorthodox approach to social media and refrain from sharing any personal information. This choice stems from my desire to preserve an enigmatic online persona and to retain a sense of mystery. I find that this allows me to engage in more meaningful conversations, as people are often intrigued by the unknown. Sample 10 Female Male In a bid to embrace the concept of digital mindfulness, I have refrained from sharing any personal information on social media platforms. This decision encourages me to be more present in my day-to-day life and allows me to fully immerse myself in the experiences and conversations I have with others, without the distractions or complications that social media can often introduce.
